name: Julien Sanchez - § 76 - Am 29
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 76. Recalls that the Ukraine Facility, established by Regulation (EU) 2024/79227, is the EU’s main instrument to support Ukraine’s recovery, reconstruction and reforms, providing up to EUR 50 billion for the period 2024-2027; notes the role of the Framework Agreement between the EU and Ukraine28 in setting out safeguards to prevent and address fraud and corruption affecting the EU’s financial interests, including cooperation with OLAF; takes note of the designation of the State Audit Service of Ukraine as the national anti-fraud coordination point; considers, however, that the existing safeguards are manifestly insufficient in the light of the high-level corruption cases acknowledged in paragraph 74 of this resolution; calls on the Commission to introduce, prior to any further disbursements, mandatory cost-based reimbursement, full public disclosure of final beneficiaries, and direct and unconditional access for OLAF and the EPPO to all relevant procurement and financial data; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 27 27 Regulation (EU) 2024/792 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 29 February 2024 establishing the Ukraine Facility (OJ L, 2024/792, 29.2.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/792/oj). 28 28 Framework Agreement of 22 May 2024 between the EU and Ukraine on specific arrangements for implementation of Union funding under the Ukraine Facility.
